tools.name: find_contact
tools.description: Find who a person is and their email address, from a LinkedIn profile address, an email, a GitHub login, a full name with their company or its domain, or a name selected on a page with the text around it, a profile on X or a YouTube channel included. Resolve the person first: use the profile or empl

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Reopen someone this account found before, by the person ID find_contact returned, their email or their LinkedIn address. Free. Answers not_found for anyone the account has not found.

tools.name: get_services
tools.description: The lookup API, its OpenAPI document and the plans, for agents that call the API directly. Needs no key.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_contact · Private data: find_contact, get_contact, get_services · Public sink: find_contact, get_contact.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_contact · Private data: find_contact, get_contact, get_services · Public sink: find_contact, get_contact

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
